brand.name: MATTER+ENERGY
brand.manifestoLeft: Matter+Energy is the creative agency where the seniors do the work — moving brands with culture, through chaos, towards presence.
brand.network: MATTER + ENERGY is part of FLAGCX フラグ, the largest independent creative services network in LATAM.
brand.footerStatement: In an era where everything is abstracted, there is an urgent need to return to the fundamentals, to affirm why matter matters and why embodied existence is essential. We explore the transformation of creative energy into tangible forms, celebrating presence, awareness, relationships and the interplay of forces shaping brands.

intros.home: Everyone can make everything now. Almost nobody can tell you what’s worth making. MATTER is the creative agency where the seniors do the work, with no pyramid between you and the craft. We took the pyramid out and put instruments in its place.
intros.work: Everyone can make everything now. What you can’t buy everywhere is someone who knows what to make — and what to throw away. Every piece here was made and signed by the senior you’d meet in the room.
intros.archive: The full body of work. Fewer projects, held longer, each one born from what makes its brand unmistakably itself. If it could belong to anyone, it isn’t here.
intros.news: Reports, interviews, playlists and signals from the people who make the work. Judgment is built in public. This is where we build ours.
intros.about: What you pay for here is judgment: senior people who decide what ships, what doesn’t, and what a brand means next. The senior who sells the work is the senior who makes it.

opening.line1: The world is abstract. Presence is the scarce thing.
opening.line2: Here, the seniors do the work. No pyramid between you and the craft.
opening.line3: Our own instruments absorb the rest.

values.title: Presence and Commitment
values.copy: Be here, fully. In an age of distraction, attention is power. We choose to pay attention to what matters, to move with intention, to create from the ground up. No shortcuts.

values.title: The Beauty of Process
values.copy: Transformation is not a straight line. It’s an excavation, a layering, a constant shedding of what no longer serves. We embrace the unpolished, the unfinished, the work in progress. This is where real change takes root.

values.title: Radical Collaboration
values.copy: We don’t believe in hierarchy for hierarchy’s sake. The best work emerges when we all have skin in the game. This is collaboration as a shared risk, a collective pursuit, a trust in each other’s strengths.

values.title: Energy as Essence
values.copy: Beyond product, beyond service—our core is energy. The drive to create, the spark of connection, the fire of curiosity. It’s about tapping into what makes us feel alive, what makes us human, and infusing that into everything we touch.

about.headline: A Storehouse Of Creative Energy

columns.label: (I) What You’re Buying
columns.copy:
Everyone can make everything now. Almost nobody can tell you what’s worth making.

What we sell is judgment: senior people who decide what ships, what doesn’t, and what a brand means for the next five years.

The work that leaves here shouldn’t travel well between brands. It is born from what makes each one unmistakably itself.

columns.label: (II) How We’re Built
columns.copy:
A creative house with nobody between the client and the craft.

Every studio stands on its own leader and its own reputation. The senior who sells the work is the senior who makes it — in the room from first brief to final file.

The instruments absorb what repeats: the research, the bureaucracy, the repeatable hours. Human time goes where being human changes the outcome.

A person decides what ships, and nothing reaches you without a name on it. Ask which part the machine made — we’ll tell you.

columns.label: (III) The Values
columns.copy:
Senior presence — the name that carries the work is in the room, start to finish.

Depth over scale — fewer projects, held longer. Would this be missed if it disappeared?

Everyone builds a name — taste, authorship, a point of view the market quotes.

Autonomy with accountability — real decisions, made in the open.

Human-led, AI-fluent — instruments absorb the repeatable; people keep the judgment.

Made, not described — the thing exists before it is defended. A deck is not evidence.

columns.label: (IV) The Deal
columns.copy:
Judgment isn’t inherited. It’s built — by making, questioning, and returning to the work until it earns its place. People here get real responsibility early, and protected time to keep sharpening it.

The promise has two sides, written down. Ours: clarity, support, tools, trust, and the room early. Yours: run your part like it’s yours — standard high, ambition out loud.

We leave room by design, and turn work down before growth starts consuming what makes growth possible. Built to stay.

about.statement: Abundance Should Make People More Valuable, Not Less.
about.refuse: We are not built to scale. We are built to stay. Which means some work is not for us. Volume production. Performance media at scale. Anything priced per unit. And if a project only needs execution, we are the wrong call. We will tell you that in the first conversation rather than the third. Most work now could have come from anywhere. Ours couldn’t. We leave the fingerprints on.

framework.title: Segmentation & Insights
framework.copy: We listen before we build. Segmentation and insights to find out who an audience actually is — not who a deck says they are. Panels to test ideas against real people. Ongoing social and cultural listening to catch a signal before it becomes a trend. Every project starts here. Insight that isn’t grounded in real behavior is just opinion with a font.

framework.title: Strategy & Positioning / Brand Architecture
framework.copy: We define what a brand is for. Positioning, brand architecture — how a brand’s products, sub-brands and business units relate to each other and to the whole. The output isn’t a deck. It is a decision a brand can hold onto for years.

framework.title: Visual & Verbal Systems
framework.copy: Matter into meaning. We build the systems that make a brand recognizable — visual and verbal — so it holds together whether it is on a billboard or in a tweet.

framework.title: Storytelling & Content
framework.copy: Energy into motion. Strategy doesn’t move anyone until it becomes a story. We write and produce the content that carries a brand’s point of view into the world — narrative, messaging, tone.

framework.title: Integrated Marketing
framework.copy: Where it all becomes real. Full campaigns, social and influencer strategy, PR and social communications — working as one connected effort, not six disconnected vendors.
